formats.key: buyBulkArtworks(bytes32 r_,bytes32 s_,uint8 v_,(uint256 price,uint256 cost,uint256 expiryTime,address destination,uint256 nonce,uint256 seriesID,uint16 quantity,(address recipient,uint256 bps)[] revenueShares,bool payByVaultContract) saleData_)
effects: When payByVaultContract is false, the signer pays msg.value, which must equal saleData_.price in ETH; that price is split between the revenue-share recipients and the costReceiver.
When payByVaultContract is true, the vault pays the price and msg.value is not checked: any ETH the signer sends stays in the contract and is not refunded.
`quantity` artworks from series seriesID, picked on chain as the next purchasable token IDs, go from the contract to `destination`.
The signed nonce of `destination` is used up.
formats.shown: Purchase artworks in bulk: "Buy N from series S", with Price, Platform cost, Recipient, Series ID, Quantity, Nonce, expiry, Pay via vault and revenue shares.

findings.title: buyBulkArtworks is payable with no @.value field; in vault mode the ETH sent is unchecked and unshown.
findings.evidence: FeralfileArtworkV4_2.sol buyBulkArtworks: `if (saleData_.payByVaultContract) { vaultV2.payForSaleV2(...) } else { if (saleData_.price != msg.value) revert ...}`; only the non-vault branch ties msg.value to price. The descriptor has no "@.value" field.

findings.title: buyBulkArtworks "Price" reads as paid by the signer even when the vault pays it.
findings.evidence: descriptor field saleData_.price label "Price"; code: with payByVaultContract true, vaultV2.payForSaleV2 funds the sale, not msg.value.
findings.fix: Show @.value as the signer's payment and label price "Sale price (paid by you or the vault)".

findings.title: buyBulkArtworks "Platform cost" looks like an extra charge but is part of the price.
findings.evidence: code: `totalRevenue = saleData_.price - saleData_.cost`; leftOver = price - distributedRevenue goes to costReceiver. Case 6 shows Price 0.5 ETH and Platform cost 0.05 ETH as two lines.

findings.title: buyBulkArtworks interpolatedIntent omits the price paid and the recipient of the artworks.
findings.evidence: descriptor interpolatedIntent "Buy {saleData_.quantity} from series {saleData_.seriesID}"; case 6 renders "Buy 5 from series 7".
findings.fix: "Buy {saleData_.quantity} artworks from series {saleData_.seriesID} for {saleData_.price} to {saleData_.destination}" (or use @.value).

findings.title: buyBulkArtworks picks the token IDs bought on chain from storage, so they cannot be shown.
findings.fix: None; quantity and series are shown.

effects: Owner only: sets mintable=false permanently, so mintArtworks can never run again, and opens the sale (_selling=true).

findings.evidence: FeralfileArtworkV4_2.sol: `function setVault(address) external pure override { revert FunctionNotSupported(); }`; descriptor intent "Set vault contract".
findings.fix: Remove the format, or set the intent to "Not supported (always fails); use setVaultV2".
